notes.title: v1.0.28 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed some additional bugs
 - On controller, no fighting between scene-assigned inputs
 - Cannot exit dungeons while in combat any more
 - Fixed reset variables for winning / losing against an enemy in a dungeon
 - Fixed movement between screens issue

notes.title: Quality Of Life Patch #1
notes.content:
First round of bug reports are in, and the first series of bug fixes!
 CHANGELOG:
 - Added a Bug Report option in the Settings Menu
 - Fixed more controller support issues
 - Player cannot move while the camera is moving between map cells
 - Issues with higher rank items not being categorized by the shops properly
 - Monster artwork + name fixes
